blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The International Criminal Court has been urged to shorten the questioning time of one of the prosecution witness during former President Rodrigo Duterte’s crimes against humanity trial, as her lawyers said that the events involving her children continue to cause her severe distress. In a Nov. 10 submission to the court, the common legal representatives of the victims said they supported the prosecution’s Oct. 7 request to admit the witness’ prior recorded testimony as evidence.
